visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a dark blue suit and black turtleneck stands against a stark white background, gesturing widely with his hands as if addressing an audience. (2) The scene shifts to the same individual now wearing a silver-white wig and a white lace vest over a black shirt; he is in a cluttered indoor room with lockers and boxes, looking off-camera. (3) Back in the suit, he sits at a wooden desk containing a tall candle and an antique metal kettle, looking frantically at a piece of folded tissue. (4) Close-up of his hands meticulously folding a white paper napkin on the wooden table surface. (5) The wig persona returns, sitting at the table and speaking with exaggerated facial expressions, pointing a finger. (6) He presents a package of 3M Scotch-Brite sponges, then pulls a single yellow-and-green sponge from his suit pocket. (7) A split-screen or quick cut shows him in the wig shouting 'You're lying!' while the suit-wearing persona looks shocked. (8) The wig persona dances and gestures while holding a yellow sponge, appearing in a kitchen or living room area with shelves full of items and cardboard boxes. (9) Close-up shot of hands rubbing the yellow sponge in a stainless steel bowl of water to create thick white soap foam. (10) The suit persona appears again, holding his hands up in a 'peace' sign, followed by the wig persona slamming a large bowl onto the table. (11) A fast-paced montage shows the wig persona cleaning various items including a blue ceramic bowl, a pink mug, and a stainless steel pot using the different sides of the 3M sponges. (12) He sits on the floor of the messy room, appearing distressed, before suddenly perking up to announce a promotion. (13) The video concludes with a static product shot of two 3M sponge packs on a gray surface with large yellow and black text overlays.
